questions.stem: Why is enzyme inhibition important in medicine?

options.text: Inhibitors are used to increase enzyme activity in patients
It is not important in medicine
Many drugs work as enzyme inhibitors to block harmful metabolic pathways
Enzyme inhibitors provide energy to cells

questions.explanation: Many medicines work as enzyme inhibitors. For example, some antibiotics inhibit bacterial enzymes, and some drugs inhibit enzymes involved in disease processes, making enzyme inhibition very important in medicine.
